vo.text: Your touchscreen does not need to feel pressure from your finger.
vo.speak: Your touchscreen does not need to feel pressure from your finger.

vo.text: It senses a tiny change in an electric field.
vo.speak: It senses a tiny change in an electric field.

vo.text: Under the glass sits a grid of transparent electrodes.
vo.speak: Under the glass sits a grid of transparent electrodes.

vo.text: A small electrical signal moves through them.
vo.speak: A small electrical signal moves through them.

vo.text: Your finger conducts a little charge and disturbs the field nearby.
vo.speak: Your finger conducts a little charge and disturbs the field nearby.

vo.text: The controller measures which rows and columns change.
vo.speak: The controller measures which rows and columns change.

vo.text: Their crossing point becomes your touch.
vo.speak: Their crossing point becomes your touch.

vo.text: That is why a normal glove blocks the signal.
vo.speak: That is why a normal glove blocks the signal.

vo.text: A conductive glove works because it lets the field reach your skin.
vo.speak: A conductive glove works because it lets the field reach your skin.

vo.text: So the glass is not just watching your finger. It is listening for a tiny electrical disturbance.
vo.speak: So the glass is not just watching your finger. It is listening for a tiny electrical disturbance.
